steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Freight Workers and.....wait, what? Sorry. The name you said was too long to jot down.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: 'Nuova Volsinii Freight Workers and Truckers Mutual Aid Association'...we need to study the workers' unions in Victoria and Columbia.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: If we want to fight back against the famiglie' threats, we first need to unite amongst ourselves. There's strength in numbers.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: The shipping industry is the lifeblood of every city. To date, the famiglie have established control of this industry in every other city in Siracusa.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: We can't let that happen here.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: In Nuova Volsinii, trucking is not controlled by gangsters. The shipping industry belongs to the drivers and every other upstanding citizen of Nuova Volsinii.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: But, why me?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: I used to be a truck driver for Sommer's grocery store, albeit a good one.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: In Volsinii, there are only a few government employees who haven't accepted bribes from the famiglie—you could count them on two hands.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: That's because...

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I'm sorry, Eirene. I privately looked into your and Sommer's past. I know about that tragic incident, and I truly apologize.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I was thinking, if you simply hate the Famiglia that set fire to your supermarket, you could have easily accepted help from another family to carry out your revenge...

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: But you didn't do that.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: It's just a little speculation on my part. Forgive me if I offend you.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Thank you... Judge Lavinia.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Eirene, regardless of whether you are the best choice to head the Truckers' Union, I believe you are a kind woman.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Please give this invitation some serious consideration, okay?

steps.name: Judge's Assistant
steps.text: Signorina Lavazza, please wait a moment. Judge Lavinia is still holding court. She will come see you when she is finished.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: A—Alright. No rush.

steps.name: Judge's Assistant
steps.text: Those documents you're holding, are they for Judge Lavinia? I'll give them to her.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: No! At least, not yet. I'll give them to her in a little while.
As Eirene speaks, she tightens her grip on the notebook in her hand.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: May I ask you, that case the judge is handling, is it some dispute between the corporations or that car crash that happened last night?

steps.name: Judge's Assistant
steps.text: Neither.

steps.name: Judge's Assistant
steps.text: Strictly speaking, it's not a trial, but an appeal that even Judge Lavinia might not be able to handle.

steps.name: Judge's Assistant
steps.text: The main litigant is a Nuova Volsinii civilian, but it's a unique situation.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Judge Lavinia is the Supreme Justice of Nuova Volsinii. What kind of case would she not... can I go listen in?

steps.name: Judge's Assistant
steps.text: Of course. You can sit and listen to the proceedings while you wait for the judge.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: ...I'll contact the Montelupe municipal government right away and ask them to help us catch the culprit.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: In the meanwhile, we will apply for Nuova Volsinii to take jurisdiction of this case.

steps.name: Sad Citizen
steps.text: Do you think you'll be able to do it?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I'll do everything I can. This isn't the first change of venue request we've submitted this year.

steps.name: Sad Citizen
steps.text: But all your previous requests were denied, right?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: ...Even if they deny our request, I'll push hard to ensure my colleagues in Montelupe conduct a fair trial, so that the murderer is punished.

steps.name: Sad Citizen
steps.text: Fair?

steps.name: Sad Citizen
steps.text: Judge Lavinia, we all know what's going to happen if you do that.

steps.name: Sad Citizen
steps.text: They'll say it was my big brother who got drunk in the bar and started this. They'll claim the mafiosi were acting in self-defense, when a terrible accident occurred.

steps.name: Sad Citizen
steps.text: You know that's not what happened!

steps.name: Sad Citizen
steps.text: He went on a business trip to Montelupe because of Carnevale and somehow offended the mafiosi there. They beat him to death in a dirty alley...

steps.name: Sad Citizen
steps.text: Your Honor, I heard the mafiosi have already taken the judges and court workers out to dinner. You're telling me you can make sure there's a fair trial?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Sad Citizen
steps.text: My brother was a good man. He never did a bad deed in his life. We were among the first citizens to apply to live in Nuova Volsinii. Everyone loved my brother.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I am very sorry.

steps.name: Sad Citizen
steps.text: You don't need to be sorry. This sort of thing happens in Siracusa all the time, does it not?

steps.name: Sad Citizen
steps.text: Your Honor, I want revenge.

steps.name: Sad Citizen
steps.text: I'm going to do this my way, by a method that is tried and true in our beloved Siracusa. I'm going to sell my possessions and hire an assassin or go seek refuge with another rival Famiglia that holds a grudge against them.

steps.name: Sad Citizen
steps.text: But if I do that, will I be violating Nuova Volsinii's laws?

steps.name: Sad Citizen
steps.text: Will you pass judgment on me? Will Nuova Volsinii banish me forever?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Yes, as required by the New Urban Management Act.

steps.name: Sad Citizen
steps.text: Nuova Volsinii's laws are very strict and very effective. However, they only apply within Nuova Volsinii's borders.

steps.name: Sad Citizen
steps.text: Don't you find that to be funny?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I know it sounds cruel, but that's how the laws were written. Nuova Volsinii is a very special place, and its laws are what make it special, but they are also its greatest shortcoming.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: But please believe me. I will do everything I can to help you.

steps.name: Sad Citizen
steps.text: No, Your Honor, my brother was wrongfully killed...

steps.name: Sad Citizen
steps.text: I want to... revoke my Nuova Volsinii citizenship and return to Montelupe.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: How could this have happened?

steps.name: Judge's Assistant
steps.text: *sigh* There is nothing we can do about it.

steps.name: Judge's Assistant
steps.text: Nuova Volsinii is a special city. The New Urban Management Act, both in its content and its applicability, conflicts with Siracusa's historical traditions.

steps.name: Judge's Assistant
steps.text: In a sense, it is completely alien to the country as a whole. This is precisely why the law must stand.

steps.name: Judge's Assistant
steps.text: This is not the first time we've seen something like this happen this year. Sorry, I should not tell you these things.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: No. Thank you for sharing this with me.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Eirene, the union can't help me fix this.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: This is Nuova Volsinii. Its laws bend for no one.
The sad citizen walks by them, saying nothing. Eirene cannot read any expression on his face.

steps.name: Judge's Assistant
steps.text: Signorina Lavazza, Judge Lavinia is handling the paperwork for this case. I'll go talk to her. You wait for me here.

steps.name: Judge's Assistant
steps.text: Judge Lavinia, are you doing OK?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I'm fine. Where's Eirene? Didn't you say she's been waiting for me for a while now?

steps.name: Judge's Assistant
steps.text: That's weird. She was just here.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Did she tell you anything new? Did she find the missing truck?

steps.name: Judge's Assistant
steps.text: (Shakes head)

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Knowing her, she probably discovered some new evidence all of a sudden and rushed out without saying goodbye. She'll get in touch with us soon.

steps.name: Judge's Assistant
steps.text: By the way, the police station just called.

steps.name: Judge's Assistant
steps.text: That Certaldo guy you were asking them to find...they located him.
Texas puts the weapon aside and opens the window.
She is a little bored.
It's the rainy season, yet there isn't a cloud in the sky. The bustling pedestrians are bathed in bright sunshine—
She almost does not recognize the plate in front of her, the one she had stepped on a year ago.
After all, last year it still belonged to Volsinii and experienced constant downpours, forcing her to spend hours every day drying her tail.
If Leontuzzo was not lying in the hospital, Texas might almost believe that Siracusa is getting better.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Boss, you stuffed those vinyl records in your suitcase... aren't you afraid they'll get scratched?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Like I got a choice!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: I don't like Siracusan smooth jazz. Sounds nice and fancy at first, but it might as well be tails brushin' the dirt while a pack of wolves gnaw at each other.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Carnevale, parades, concerts... there's gonna be music everywhere. I just wanna see some old friends, I ain't out to get my ears violated.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Old friends? You mean your people are going too?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: We used to go all the time. Now the Siracusans are throwin' another theme party, after all these years, I mean, they definitely gonna show up.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Hey, Texas! You say you ain't into it, but you got your bags packed quicker than I did!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I didn't have much to pack.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: We won't stay very long. We'll be back as soon as it's over.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Sounds like you sure somethin's definitely goin' wrong this time.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Look, Zaaro lost his game, your deal's null n' void.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: You n' Siracusa, n' those old friends, they run some games I got no interest in, but everything that needed seein' to, got seen to.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: The Last Texas ain't nothin' no more. You don't got no high hopes for Siracusa, so what's it matter to you if it gets better or worse?

spans.text: ain't nothin' no more. You don't got no high hopes for Siracusa, so what's it matter to you if it gets better or worse?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: You don't wanna say? Or you dunno?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Forget it. I mean, I'm sayin' you can stay in Lungmen to watch the house.
Texas closes the window and pulls two letters out of her pocket.
The first is an invitation from Nuova Volsinii City Hall, stamped with the court's seal and signed by Acting Mayor Leontuzzo.
The other envelope is empty. Its front side, colored purple, has a sloppy drawing of a white wolf and a bunch of grapes on the corner.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Lappland.
Eirene leaves the courthouse as if she's fleeing something.
She doesn't dare to look back on what just happened, what she experienced, or the struggles she went through.
A taxi stops right in front of her. She does not remember whether she hailed it or not.

steps.name: Chatty Driver
steps.text: Where you headed?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: The Trucker Camp.

steps.name: Chatty Driver
steps.text: Uh... never heard of it.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: 500 Viale Alito, Torino.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: It's very far from here, on the farthest plate. It's not surprising that you've never been there.

steps.name: Chatty Driver
steps.text: Tough day, huh?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Uhuh...

steps.name: Chatty Driver
steps.text: You're the gloomiest customer I've picked up since arriving in Nuova Volsinii.

steps.name: Chatty Driver
steps.text: Why are you so sad? The Carnevale parade is just a few days away. Everyone is happy about their new lives in this new city, no?

steps.name: Chatty Driver
steps.text: Speaking of which, I love this new city.

steps.name: Chatty Driver
steps.text: Look at these festively decorated streets, the wonderful parties, and the carefully prepared food. There are no famiglia around, and it hardly ever rains. The air, and our tails, are always dry.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Signorina, could we cut the chatter? I don't really feel like talking right now.

steps.name: Chatty Driver
steps.text: What is it that's got you so upset? Let's chat about it. Maybe I can help you?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: I made some mistakes. No, I should say, I failed to do some things. Or rather, I trusted the wrong people... In any case, I let people down.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Whatever. There's no way to solve my problems anyway.

steps.name: Chatty Driver
steps.text: No no no, in Siracusa, no problems are unsolvable.

steps.name: Chatty Driver
steps.text: If you can't untangle the rope, you can just cut it. If you can't unlock the chest, you can smash the lock with a hammer. There is a solution for every problem.

steps.name: Chatty Driver
steps.text: Many times, all you need to do is change your perspective and screw up your courage. Then you'll find that all the problems will resolve themselves.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Are you speaking from experience?

steps.name: Chatty Driver
steps.text: More than you can imagine.

steps.name: Chatty Driver
steps.text: After all, before becoming a taxi driver, my main job was helping my best friend solve problems.

steps.name: Chatty Driver
steps.text: Now that was someone who knew how to get into trouble, tsk.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: Claiming to be able to 'solve' problems—it sounds just like something the famiglie would do.

steps.name: Chatty Driver
steps.text: Then you've got me all wrong.

steps.name: Chatty Driver
steps.text: This is a new place; the old ways do not apply. Believe me.

steps.name: Chatty Driver
steps.text: Look, everyone's full of energy, everyone's full of love, and also, everyone's wearing a festive mask. How fun.

steps.name: Chatty Driver
steps.text: Sometimes I really wonder, what are hiding behind these masks?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: I don't understand what you're saying.

steps.name: Chatty Driver
steps.text: It's simple—wearing a mask 'imposed' on you can make it hard to breathe.

steps.name: Chatty Driver
steps.text: Many times, you actually know what to do; the answer is right there, crystal clear. It's just that for various reasons, we refuse to face it.

steps.name: Chatty Driver
steps.text: But if it could make things easier for yourself... then why not?

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: ....Sorry, but could you stop for a second?
The driver steps on the brake.

She doesn't know why, but Eirene has the feeling that, from the moment she got in the car, the driver has been waiting for this exact instruction. She even catches a glimpse of the driver's bright smile in the rearview mirror.

steps.name: Eirene
steps.text: I'm not going to the Trucker Camp. I want to go somewhere else.

steps.name: Chatty Driver
steps.text: Your wish is my command.
